env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# lib -> mid -> main. mid.Render is exported and passes its type parameter
# to the comptime generic lib.Kind inside an option, and mid.Layout reaches
# lib.Names inside a tuple through the unexported forwarding function
# layout. A caller in another package cannot instantiate either, so mid
# fails at compile time at the forwarding site, logos eject refuses with the
# same text, and nothing reaches the comptime stub at run time (SPEC 2.5,
# T-205).
cd w
! logos build ./...
stderr 'mid[/\\]mid.lgo:6:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Render forwards type parameter T to comptime generic Kind; a caller in another package cannot instantiate it'
stderr 'mid[/\\]mid.lgo:10:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Layout forwards type parameter T to forwarding function layout; a caller in another package cannot instantiate it'
! stderr 'panic'
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'mid[/\\]mid.lgo:6:\d+: \[comptime::exported_forwarder\] exported function Render forwards type parameter T to comptime generic Kind; a caller in another package cannot instantiate it'
! exists out

# Unexported forwarding functions that pass their type parameter inside an
# option, a tuple and a struct expand per instantiation, natively and in
# ejected code, and both print the same.
cd ../u
logos run .
stdout '^other struct AB true$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1274/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1274/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fwdforms

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

func Kind[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	}
	return "other"
}

func Names[T any]() string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		s = s + f.Name
	}
	return s
}

-- w/mid/mid.lgo --
package mid

import "example.com/fwdforms/lib"

func Render[T any]() string {
	return lib.Kind[T?]()
}

func Layout[T any]() string {
	return layout[T]()
}

func layout[T any]() string {
	return lib.Names[(a T, b int)]()
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fwdforms/mid"
)

type P struct {
	A int
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(mid.Render[P](), mid.Layout[int]())
}

-- u/go.mod --
module example.com/fwdlocal

go 1.27

-- u/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

func Kind[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	}
	return "other"
}

func Names[T any]() string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		s = s + f.Name
	}
	return s
}

-- u/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/fwdlocal/lib"
)

type P struct {
	A int
}

func option[T any]() string {
	return lib.Kind[T?]()
}

func tuple[T any]() string {
	return lib.Kind[(a T, b int)]()
}

func names[T any]() string {
	return lib.Names[struct {
		A T
		B []T
	}]()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(option[P](), tuple[int](), names[string](), hold(P{A: 1}))
}

-- u/hold.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/fwdlocal/lib"

func hold[T any](v T) bool {
	var x T? = v
	_ = lib.Kind[T?]()
	return x != nil
}
